callbacks=object.__new__(Callbacks);callbacks.callbacks=[Recorder("one"),Recorder("two")]
callbacks.on_run_start(OmegaConf.create({}));callbacks.on_run_end(OmegaConf.create({}))
print(seen)
assert seen==[("start","one"),("start","two"),("end","two"),("end","one")]
